title: Vindicator Guide
subtitle: DDD / Frigate Killer
body:
# Vindicator

---

The Vindicator is our DDD (frigate killer) ship. Your job is to web and kill the Sansha frigates so the marauders can focus on the big stuff. This guide covers general tips for applying your DPS to frigates, then a breakdown of each site.

## Fit & Skills

- DDD is best done with a 4 web Vindicator.
- Follow the fit on the Fits page.
- Train Minmatar and Gallente Battleship. Aim for **Minmatar Battleship 5**.
- Abyssal webs are strongly recommended. Aim for about base stat abyssals with 15.5km+ range and 63.5%+ web strength.
- The Drop booster gives you a tracking bonus and is quite useful.
- Run Pyrolancea for extra DPS.

## General Tips

- Your effective range is roughly **6km out to your web range**.
- **Overheat your webs.** It gives them a few extra kilometers of range and costs very little in paste to repair.
- Use **Void** when targets are close and **Null** when they are further away. Memorize your optimal range with each ammo type.
- Get your speed as close to 0m/s as possible when shooting to maximise tracking.
- Splitting guns 4-4 is best when you have good skills. If you're struggling for damage, keep your guns grouped together.
- If you are burning, or the frigates aren't webbed, keep shooting anyway. A lucky hit is better than no hit.
- You will need to learn your anchor positions yourself, but ask if you're unsure.

## Sit Still, Kill Frigates

Hitting frigates with large guns is not easy. You need to be webbing your targets and keeping your transversal velocity as low as possible (add the Transversal column to your overview). Burning around with your MWD on means missed shots and no dead frigates.

- Be in position **before** the wave spawns. If aggro switches or doesn't go where it should, you may have to move.
- There is a priority order to frigates, but always shoot the ones **closest to optimal with the lowest transversal**. You'll kill them much faster, so keep checking your overview.
- Light drones are fine as support but they are **not** your main damage, so keep shooting. Split gun groups help kill multiple frigates at once and keep your drones busy.
- If the frigate spawn is pulled away from you, switch to Null. Do not be idle.
- You are not a marauder. You are free to burn whenever you need to in order to do your job.

## The Meatshield

The meatshield (MS) is listed in the fleet MOTD. It acts as the initial aggro for most sites and waves, so this is where the Sansha frigates will be going. Use it to find your anchor and stay near it.

## Contests

Your role doesn't really change in contests: shoot frigates as best you can. Waves die really fast, so burn straight to your anchor and do as much DPS as you can.

In **TCRC contests**, focus on shooting the tower with the rest of the fleet and keep the Niarjas locked in case they jam a marauder. If they do, kill them ASAP.

## Site Breakdowns

### TPPH - Start with null loaded.

- **Room 1:** Burn forward one or two prop cycles. Prioritise Schmaeels, then Tamas.
- **Room 2:** Burn forward 1-2 prop cycles. Kill the four frigates as fast as you can, Schmaeels first.
- **Room 3:** Burn directly to your anchor, between the 2nd wave spawn and the MS but on the side closer to the MS. After the 1st wave frigates are dead switch to void. When the 2nd wave spawns and the MS pulls aggro, you should be well within web range. Schmaeels first, then Tamas, then work through the rest. The wave is almost always pushed, so more frigates spawn on the final wave. If you're shooting or webbing frigates when the final wave spawns you will likely get aggro. You should actively avoid this because you will annoy the shit out of everyone in fleet and be worse at your job. Marauders will help you clean up at this point.

### NRF - Start with null loaded

- **Wave 1:** Burn directly to your anchor. Do not sit on the beacon, do not hand break. Shoot and web frigates as you go. After wave 1 frigates switch to void.
- **Waves 2, 3 & 4:** Anchor above the MS and slightly further into the site between them and the wave spawns. Schmaeels first, then Tamas. Burn in on the 4th wave to help shoot everything else **once the frigates are dead**. Webbing Romis helps a lot.

### TCRC - Start with null loaded

**Niarjas are your top priority.** They jam and neut, and they respawn.

1. When you land on the beacon, sit still and use Null to quickly kill the closest Niarja.
2. Immediately after it dies start burning to the tower.
3. While burning web and kill the remaining Niarja. You may find hand breaking will make this take less total time. You may find a window to switch to void here, but it doesn't really matter.
4. Once anchored, kill the respawning Niarja. Between Niarja respawns, kill untagged Schmaeels. Kill each Niarja the moment it respawns. 
5. When no untagged Schmaeels are left, web the X's and help shoot the tower.
6. X-tagged Schmaeels respawn after a set time if killed, but never once the tower is dead. When the tower is around **20% structure**, kill the remaining X's so the fleet can make quick work of the Auga and exit the site promptly.
